diagnostics_evidence_empty: Nothing was recorded for this game.
diagnostics_identity_hint: Derived from a secret held on this machine and today's date, so it changes at midnight UTC. The secret is never sent.
diagnostics_mod_disabled_description: {name} stays out of the next game.
diagnostics_notice_collected_errors: Errors and crashes in the manager itself
diagnostics_notice_collected_identity: An id that changes every day and can't be traced back to you
diagnostics_notice_collected_mods: Which mods were involved when a game breaks, as a scrambled id rather than their names
diagnostics_notice_collected_session: How a game session ended: whether it ran fine, or what went wrong when it didn't
diagnostics_notice_collected_versions: Your manager version, Windows version and game patch
diagnostics_notice_never_body: Your Riot account, your IP address, your Windows username and your file paths never leave your machine.
diagnostics_notice_settings_hint: You can change this whenever you like, in Settings under *Privacy*.
diagnostics_notice_why_body: Collecting game session diagnostics helps us find bugs sooner and more reliably. That means quicker fixes for you, including for problems nobody ever gets round to reporting.
diagnostics_overlay_disabled_label: Overlay turned off by the scan
diagnostics_privacy_description: What the manager reports about how it runs, and what it never sends.
diagnostics_report_copied_description: Paste it into a bug report or a support thread.
diagnostics_reset_identity_hint: Breaks the link to everything reported so far, at once rather than at midnight.

match.countPlural=one: League could not compile {count} shader variant.
match.countPlural=other: League could not compile {count} shader variants.

match.countPlural=one: League could not compile {count} shader variant, and then drew a material that had no pipeline.
match.countPlural=other: League could not compile {count} shader variants, and then drew a material that had no pipeline.

diagnostics_shader_pipeline_description: League drew a material that had no pipeline.
diagnostics_shader_unnamed_description: The failed compiles name no vertex shader. League builds shader programs only for the CustomShaderDef objects in data/shaders/shaders.bin, so a mod that defines a shader in any other bin replaces the game's copy with one that has no programs.
diagnostics_telemetry_row_description: Send anonymous reports when a game session ends badly, or when the manager hits an error it did not expect. No account, no address, no file paths and no mod names.
hint.close-game: Close League of Legends and wait for it to exit, then start the patcher again.
hint.check-game-path: Check the League of Legends installation path in Settings.
hint.copy-report: Copy the report when you ask for help.
hint.disable-suspect: A mod that references a file it does not ship stops the read. Disable the suspect and play again.
hint.elevate: League may run elevated, so let the host elevate or run LTK Manager as administrator.
hint.free-memory: Close what else is running, and leave free space on the drive League is installed on.

match.countPlural=one: {count} modded archive was in this game. Disable any that replace textures with much larger ones and play again.
match.countPlural=other: {count} modded archives were in this game. Disable any that replace textures with much larger ones and play again.

hint.open-project: Open the project in the editor.
hint.reimport-mod: Re-import or rebuild the mod the scan named, then start the patcher again.
hint.remove-skinhack: Disable the mod the scan named, then start the patcher again.
hint.repair-game: Repair the install in the Riot Client, because the scan objected to a file the game ships.
hint.repair-install: Repair the install in the Riot Client when the rebuild does not help.
hint.scan-up-front: Turn on Scan every WAD up front, because the DLL scanned archives on demand and the game ended inside its first minute.
hint.shader-definition: Remove the CustomShaderDef that the mod defines outside data/shaders/shaders.bin, and keep the material's link to the game's shader.
hint.signature: The host ran elevated, so check the DLL's signature and whether an antivirus blocked it.
hint.system-checks: Run the System checks on the Diagnostics page.
hint.texture-dimensions: A modded texture whose width or height is not a multiple of 4 is the common cause, so check the dimensions of any texture you changed.
hint.update-driver: Update the graphics driver, and check the display settings when the update does not help.
